ground_solver.input: byte-identical sanitized population-sector H, scalar identity removed
ground_solver.reuse: same H, sector, orbital/state gauge identity and same numerical gates only
ground_solver.degenerate_ground_selection: indeterminate rather than select a ground vector using PF/truth performance

unitary.construction: left-apply unchanged component_exponential gates to identity, iter_s2_sequence_steps order, canonical current_m3 binary64 sequence

direct_branch.load: hash-verified pure function plus _phase_distance only, no whole historical runner
direct_branch.isolated_namespace: np, time, scipy.linalg.schur, practical._cost bound to a local continuous beta*K/[t*(epsilon-error)] function; no historical practical runner import
direct_branch.solver: complex Schur, output='complex', check_finite=False after explicit finite gate
direct_branch.initial_branch: maximum same-H exact-ground overlap at first fixed time; no new small-time anchor
direct_branch.continuation: ascending three fixed times, maximum overlap with previous selected eigenvector
direct_branch.cluster: principal phase separation <=1e-8 rad is unresolved; fail closed, no individual/projector rescue
direct_branch.target_phase_gap: minimum absolute principal wrapped angle(lambda_j/lambda_target), rad
direct_branch.warning_handling: record warning and indeterminate physical-branch/success label; do not substitute comparator branch
direct_branch.relative_alias: retain principal relative convention; no lifting using prediction to obtain agreement

scoring.branch_diagnostic: abs(delta_M-delta_direct) < g_phase/(2*t); strict inequality, finite resolved gap required
scoring.absolute_energy_diagnostic: E_H_Ritz+delta_M versus E0+delta_direct only with matching physical lift, never as a ground certificate
scoring.width_coverage: abs(delta_M-delta_direct)<=w_M; empirical coverage not rigorous certification
scoring.B0: score baseline safety too; unsafe anchor is not a safe fallback
scoring.gap_units: g_phase rad; g_E=g_phase/t Ha; g_chord unit-circle distance; g_target is not g_rho_others

future_barrier: cheap/q freeze -> conditional M1 -> H1 freeze -> q=0 comparator completion -> seven-file prediction commit and byte gate -> exact/direct/gap -> immutable scoring
